steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Order. Each backlog item is placed by its age.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 item older than 30 days has no owner

findings.title: Older than 30 days with no owner
findings.fix: Assign an owner or close the item

findings.title: Priority does not match the stated impact
findings.fix: Re-rank the item by its impact

outcome.notChecked: Whether the items are still needed.

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] OPS-104.md:12  Older than 30 days with no owner.
       Fix: Assign an owner or close the item.
[medium] OPS-106.md:19  Priority does not match the stated impact.
       Fix: Re-rank the item by its impact.
[low] OPS-102.md:26  Item with no owner.
       Fix: Assign an owner.
Not checked: Whether the items are still needed.
pros: Checks an item with no owner, an item older than 30 days, and a priority that does not match the item's stated impact.
cons: Not checked: Whether the items are still needed.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-ops-backlog-review skill on the records for this review.
